author: CNN
description: Cultural capital and a post-Covid boom in travel have seen tourists flock to Japan. CNN Travel Editor Lilit Marcus explains why mass tourism is not always a good thing for a place like Japan, and asks whether Japan's booming tourism industry made the country a victim of its own success.
title: How Japan fights overtourism

author: CNN
description:
Close personal aides joined President Donald Trump aboard a smaller aircraft flying out of Turkey last month after he snuck out of a larger plane, according to a person familiar with the arrangements, while several Cabinet members remained on the legacy Air Force One that flew without him.

The scramble to devise the furtive plan to sneak Trump out of the country on an alternate jet was prompted by a specific threat to Air Force One by a shoulder-fired missile, according to the person familiar with the matter. The threat emerged on the final day of last month’s NATO summit in Turkey.

The NewsNight panel debates the plane swap and other security concerns surrounding the president’s travel.

0:00 The elaborate ruse to put Trump on a different plane (August 10)
4:15 The optics of President Trump hiding in a catering truck (August 10)
7:41 Was it right to leave everyone else on Air Force One? (August 11)

title: Could Trump have avoided the chaotic AF1 swap?

author: CNN
description:
Firefighters across Europe struggled against multiple fires Friday as a new wave of record-breaking heat baked a swath of Europe.

Also, record breaking torrential rains has fallen in Japan’s Chiba Prefecture where parts of it received three-times the average August rainfall in just one day and drenching storms are rolling over the US Midwest for a sixth day early Friday, setting off more flooding in a region where hundreds of people have been forced from their homes in recent days.

CNN’s Chief Climate Correspondent Bill Weir talks about how climate change is affecting the World weather and Beccy Speight, the CEO of the Royal Society for the Protection of Birds shares how these massive wildfires are affecting wildlife and their habitats. And CNN’s Nada Bashir on the wildfires raging across England and the rest of Europe.

0:00 Is it just climate change or could El Nino have an impact too? 
3:34 Distressing images as wildfires threaten wildlife and their habitats 
9:41 Record breaking
title: Record-breaking floods, 40,000 wildfires in global 'weather whiplash'
